purpose: Three-step engineering action ladder (attention/inspect, plan turn, turn now) on top of the approved condemning limits. Thresholds are a C&W/standards decision and are intentionally absent until signed off; the dashboard must never derive tiers from unapproved numbers.
owner_question: C&W/standards to provide the numeric thresholds (and basis) per tier. Until then tiers must not be computed or displayed as engineering guidance.
